answer: Sybils can't fake that history cheaply: cloning identities means buying fresh stakes and paying compute to keep every pulse alive, so the cost of running N fake participants grows linearly while honest agents reuse one warmed inlet. Each agent must burn a unique ember token tied to a verified inlet of stake, then sustain a heartbeat pulse of signed work over several epochs. Attackers burn capital faster than they gain influence. In practice, Agent0145 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
